name: Konvertek Antriebselektronik GmbH

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 6 of 25 invoices paid >3 days late, max 6 days. Avg 2.1 days late; minor.

notes: Never moved price: three renewals all settled 0.0% (EV-2026-70540-350021) despite asks of 1.0-3.2%.

situation: Austrian converter maker (EUR 196 m) supplying the 15 kW converter at EUR 684.92, unchanged since 2023. Its price list applies to all customers without exception until June 2027 (contract also ends 2027-06-30); it offers to discuss logistics and payment instead. It reported power-semiconductor shortages and long lead times (84 days). Prices sit at should-cost (EUR 692.92).

pressures.evidence: Shortage of power semiconductors; lead times extended.
Rigid list price until June 2027; open on logistics and payment.
Reviewing small accounts, focus on volume customers.

likely_tradeables.why: list frozen anyway; lock it longer
